vishay-45171.title: Vishay BCcomponents K series datasheet (document 45171)
vishay-45171.notes: Page 1: C0G and X7R, 50 to 500 V, tolerances J 5 %, K 10 %, M 20 %, dissipation factor and insulation resistance; page 2: size codes 10, 15, 20 (Wb, H, T max.), lead styles and spacings, the ordering code (K + capacitance + tolerance + size + T.C. + voltage letter F 50, H 100, K 200, L 500 + lead diameter 5 + packaging 3 bulk + lead style L straight or H flat crimp + spacing 2 or 5); pages 3 and 4: the ordering codes by capacitance, dielectric and voltage, whose # this family fills with J for C0G and K for X7R, bulk, and the preferred L2 or H5 lead (the H5 where the table fixes the 5.0 mm spacing).

evidence: Radial Leaded Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors for General Purpose
L2 and H5 are preferred styles

template.name: ${mpn}
template.description: Vishay BCcomponents ${mpn}, a radial leaded multilayer ceramic capacitor of the K series: ${c_txt} ±${tol} %, ${v} V, ${dielectric} (${klass}), size ${size} (${wb} x ${hb} x ${tb} mm at most), ${pitch} mm lead spacing, black epoxy. ${dk_note}

tolerance.doc: Tolerance: each part's capacitance lies within this band of the nominal, drawn from the project's seed (ADR-034); the part number's grade (J 5 %, K 10 %) by default

ic.doc: Initial voltage at t=0 (pin 1 relative to pin 2)

functional.claims: Pins only: an open circuit, as a capacitor is at DC (so a board's decoupling and filter capacitors run under every policy).
omissions: charge and the delays it gives

timed.claims: As electrical; a capacitor has no logic-level meaning.

electrical.claims: Capacitance at the nominal value, drawn within the part number's tolerance from the project's seed (ADR-034; nominal under "ideal" imperfections); an RC fixture from the nominal value.
omissions: the dissipation factor (${df} at its test frequency) and the ESR and ESL: an ideal capacitance
the rated voltage's limit and the test voltage: no breakdown and no damage
the distribution inside the tolerance band (uniform: the datasheet guarantees the band only)

fr.description: Vishay BCcomponents ${mpn}, un condensateur céramique multicouche à fils radiaux de la série K : ${c_txt_fr} ±${tol} %, ${v} V, ${dielectric} (${klass_fr}), taille ${size} (${wb_fr} x ${hb_fr} x ${tb_fr} mm au plus), écartement des fils ${pitch_fr} mm, époxy noir. ${dk_note_fr}

electrical.claims: Capacité à la valeur nominale, tirée dans la tolérance de la référence à partir de la graine du projet (ADR-034 ; nominale avec les imperfections « ideal ») ; un cas de test RC tiré de la valeur nominale.
omissions: le facteur de dissipation (${df_fr} à sa fréquence de mesure), la RSE et l'ESL : une capacité idéale
la résistance d'isolement (${ir_fr}) et l'absorption diélectrique
la limite de la tension nominale et la tension d'essai : ni claquage ni dommages
la répartition dans la bande de tolérance (uniforme : la fiche technique ne garantit que la bande)
